response.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM trans WHERE date >= '1996-05-09' AND date <= '1998-01-06' AND type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ')

assumptions.assumption: trans.date is stored as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD), so the string comparison with both end dates included selects the intended range.
Rows with type VYBER or NULL are excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, as the request says to leave them out of the average.
